description: Durable archival bundle for the corrected DeepSeek V4.1 Flash OpenCode t0-t8 evaluation on the sanitized baseline (ef91057), together with the initial pre-correction aggregate run and the hardened re-score. Built from the volatile OS-temp workspaces so the completed evaluation no longer depends solely on /var/folders storage.

provenance.harness_revision_note: Timing evidence, not a recorded manifest field: the artifacts predate the current commit. t0 smoke started 2026-09-17T13:20Z (after b841597 at 13:09Z, before b69fb1f at 14:39Z); t1-t8 started 2026-09-17T14:54Z-16:55Z (at b69fb1f); the hardened re-score ran ~17:08-17:09Z using the working-tree score.py committed as 62fb894 at 17:16Z. The exact harness code for each revision is recoverable from repository history.
provenance.notes: The initial pre-correction aggregate run used baseline a437b47 (contaminated) and the historical runner; it is archived under initial-pre-correction-run/ for provenance only and is not internally comparable to the corrected per-test runs.
